notes: Mana is the only resource that matters here: every skill but Dragon's Bane is free, and the Tank model returns mana for striking, for being struck, and 5 more from Scorched Steel itself. Scorched Steel leads because it has the shortest cooldown and carries Charred, -15% damage resistance for 15s, so the debuff is up before anything else lands. Impale follows for the Impaled DoT and the Adrenaline Flow heal, Incapacitate last for 200% damage and Weakened. Dragon's Bane is a reaction rather than a rotation slot: 50 mana is the largest cost in the kit, so it only fires above 70% where the cast cannot fail and leave 'Not enough mana' in chat. On Dragonkin it applies Dragonbane, which the next skill consumes — Scorched Steel turns it into Cindered Scales for -30% resistance, Impale into Infected Wound, Incapacitate into a 3s stun. A later Impale into an Infected Wound target grants Adrenaline Surge, +15% haste and crit.
